marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead sase-17m.3.1.2 (canonical-keys) is done and closed.

What landed:

- `src/sase/plan_chain.py` now owns `AGENT_SESSION_KEY/ROLE/PARALLEL/SHELL_KEY`, `AGENT_SESSION_SEPARATOR`, and `LEGACY_AGENT_FAMILY_*` constants (the only place naming legacy keys), plus new-then-legacy accessors (`agent_session_value` etc. for mappings and objects), `set_agent_session_fields` / `strip_legacy_agent_family_keys` writer helpers, and renamed `agent_session_*` helpers with deprecated `agent_family_*` aliases so ~250 call sites keep working.
- Routed ~35 reader files (agent_meta/done.json lookups, name resolution, gate/monitor lanes, ACE loaders, wait/restart paths) through the accessors; writers (promotion, directive metadata, followup artifacts, inventory canonicalization, reclaim, wait classify) emit only new keys and drop legacy on rewrite. `family_shell_from_mapping` reads the new nested key first; v2 validation accepts both spellings.
- Added a temporary, marked bridge (`with_legacy_agent_session_keys` in `core/wire.py`) so new-keyed files still hydrate the legacy-named `AgentMetaWire`/`DoneMarkerWire` fields until wire-mirrors renames them — recorded as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` for sase-17m.3.1.3 to remove. Later phases own: Agent field renames, wire/fleet/hold/runner-slot mirrors, `family:` kind values, attach internals, and CLI output keys.
- Tests: new `tests/test_plan_chain_agent_session_keys.py` (17 tests: legacy/mixed/new reads, no-legacy writes, bridge); updated writer-output assertions across 10 test files to assert new keys and legacy absence. `sase bead epic-symbols` is clean.

Verification: `just fmt`, ruff, mypy (4892 files clean), keep-sorted and other lint gates pass; ~1000 targeted tests green. Two pre-existing failures proven identical on clean HEAD and left alone: symvision (73 repo-wide errors) and one completion bead-candidates test. I also fixed one pre-existing mypy error in `file_panel/_content.py` that was blocking the gate.
